learnings: API errors during file review should trigger automatic retries or fallback to simpler models rather than marking files as inconclusive
When a model has API failures on critical files (PKGBUILD), the audit tool should recognize this as a coverage gap and either retry or escalate, not return inconclusive
Initial PKGBUILD audits that succeed should be preserved even if subsequent full-file reviews fail, to avoid losing valid security assessments
Minor packaging quirks (like unusual permission modes) should be noted but not over-weighted when the overall pattern is clearly benign
